title: Spice & Wolf: merchant meets the wise wolf Season 2 to Debut in January
content:
The staff for the second season of the Spice & Wolf: merchant meets the wise wolf anime unveiled on Wednesday the anime's key visual and January premiere on TV Tokyo and other channels.

The anime's staff also revealed new character visuals:

Kraft Lawrence (voiced by Jun Fukuyama )

Holo (voiced by Ami Koshimizu )

Eve Bolan ( voiced by Romi Park )

Takeo Takahashi returns as chief director with Hijiri Sanpei , who directed the first season. Nobuyoshi Nagayama ( Smile Down the Runway ) and Takahiro Majima (episode director for Interspecies Reviewers ) are directing the second season at Passione . Koji Haneda ( The Faraway Paladin ) returns to design the characters with Rina Sugimoto . Kevin Penkin ( Made in Abyss , Tower of God , The Rising of The Shield Hero ) is again composing the music.

Additional staff includes:

• Color Key Artist: Tomoko Koyama

• Art Setting: Morihito Ōhara

• Art Director: Kazuhiro Inoue

• Compositing Director of Photography: Yuki Okada

• Editor: Ayako Tan

The anime's first season debuted in April 2024, and aired for two consecutive cours (quarters of a year). Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired, and also streamed an English dub .

The anime is a completely new series, which tells the story of Kraft Lawrence and his meeting with the wolf girl Holo. Jun Fukuyama returned as Kraft Lawrence, and Ami Koshimizu returned as Holo. Mai Nakahara also returned in the series as Norah Arendt.

Yen Press publishes the novels in English, and it describes the series:

The life of a traveling merchant is a lonely one, a fact with which Kraft Lawrence is well acquainted. Wandering from town to town with just his horse, cart, and whatever wares have come his way, the peddler has pretty well settled into his routine—that is, until the night Lawrence finds a wolf goddess asleep in his cart. Taking the form of a fetching girl with wolf ears and a tail, Holo has wearied of tending to harvests in the countryside and strikes up a bargain with the merchant to lend him the cunning of “Holo the Wisewolf” to increase his profits in exchange for taking her along on his travels. What kind of businessman could turn down such an offer? Lawrence soon learns, though, that having an ancient goddess as a traveling companion can be a bit of a mixed blessing. Will this wolf girl turn out to be too wild to tame?

Isuna Hasekura launched the Spice and Wolf novel series with illustrations by Jū Ayakura in 2006. The novels took a break after the 17th volume in 2011, and returned with the 18th volume in 2016. The 25th and latest volume shipped on October 9. Yen Press published the 24th novel in North America in August 2023, and is also publishing the manga adaptation. Hasekura began a spinoff series, Wolf & Parchment: New Theory Spice & Wolf , in April 2016. Yen Press is also releasing the spinoff series in English.

The novels also inspired two TV anime seasons from director Takeo Takahashi and scriptwriter Naruhisa Arakawa . The first season aired in Japan from January to March 2008, and the second season ( Spice and Wolf II ) from July to September 2009. Funimation released both seasons on home video.

A virtual reality anime followed the television anime and debuted in June 2019 for Oculus Rift, HTC VIVE, and Oculus Go Edition. A sequel debuted in December 2020.
author: ANN

title: New Votoms Anime Films Stream 1st 9 Minutes
content:
The staff for Sunrise and Production I.G 's Sōkō Kihei Votoms Haiiro no Hexe ( Armored Trooper Votoms : Die Graue Hexe or literally, Armored Trooper Votoms : The Grey Witch), the two new anime films in the Armored Trooper Votoms franchise , started streaming the first film's first nine minutes on Wednesday.

Note: The below video does not have English subtitles

Miyuki Sawashiro plays Ash Vamps (featured in visual right), a notorious and feared AT pilot called the Grey Witch. Mabuki Andou plays Maki Stauffenberg, an officer secretly assigned to look into Ash's past.

Other cast members include:

• Shinichirō Miki as Alix Barrack

• Yūki Kaji as Ignis Schweinsteiger

• Yūichi Nakamura as Fritz Gersdorf

• Satoshi Tsuruoka as Brunhart Müller

• Tomokazu Sugita as Adrian Dysler

• Kenta Miyake as Matt Hummels

• Chafūrin as Soltig van Gunnar

• Hōchū Ōtsuka as Vid Hildebrandt

• Daisuke Ono as Meteusz Julian Podolsky

• Takayuki Sugō as Weissweiler

• Takahiro Sakurai as Oliver

• Sumire Uesaka as Maintenance Girl

Mamoru Oshii is directing the two films. Ryōsuke Takahashi , director and creator of the original concept for the original 1983 Armored Trooper Votoms anime, is supervising the films. Shinobu Tsuneki ( The Legend of the Galactic Heroes: Die Neue These , Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex , Kaiju No. 8 ) and Sōkō Kihei Votoms: AT Stories manga artist Yoshiro Sōno are the mechanical designers. Kenji Kawai , who has worked with Oshii in various projects including Ghost in the Shell and Patlabor 2: The Movie , is composing the music. Mika Nakashima performs the first film's theme song "Na mo Naki Shijin no Yō ni" (Like Some Nameless Poet). Toshihiko Takamizawa , the vocalist and guitarist for the band THE ALFEE , wrote, composed, and arranged the song.

Other staff include:

• Original Character Design Concepts: Kazuchika Kise (xxxHOLiC, Made in Abyss, Fate/Grand Order The Movie Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot)

• Character Design: Shingo Ogiso, Takashi Kojima, Tetsuya Nishio

• Original Mechanical Designer: Kunio Ōkawara

• Mechanical Design: Jū Ishiguchi, Wataru Inada

• Costume Design Assistance: Katsuya Terada

• Art Design: Satoshi Takabatake, Yasumitsu Suetake, Kazushige Kanehira

• Art Director: Yūshi Honjō

• Color Key Artist: Nagisa Abe

• Compositing Director of Photography: Yūki Kawashita

• CG Directors: Yōta Tasaki, Toshihisa Yokoshima, Jō Nakajima

• Editing: Aya Hida

• Sound Director: Kazuhiro Wakabayashi

The first film will open in Japan on Friday.

The 1983 Armored Trooper Votoms anime is an iconic entry in the so-called "real robot" subgenre of mecha pioneered by Mobile Suit Gundam , characterized by robots as mass-produced military machines (with limitations in operation akin to real-life war machines) and gritty and grounded stories about war and its bitter costs.

The original 1983 anime is set during the ebb of a century-long conflict between the two nations of the Gilgamesh Confederation and the Balarant Union. The unit that dominates the battlefield is the VOTOMS (Vertical One-man Tank for Offense & Maneuvers), a class of powerful yet extremely vulnerable mecha , known as much for their firepower as they are for the high casualty numbers of their pilots due to thin armor and lack of safety measures. The protagonist, Chirico Cuvie, is a member of an elite Gilgamesh VOTOMS unit that becomes a pawn in a vast conspiracy that brands him a traitor to Gilgamesh, and leads him to cross paths with a mysterious woman.

Section23 Films ' Maiden Japan label most recently released the original anime on Blu-ray Disc in 2019 and 2020.

The original series has inspired a number of spinoff anime, including Armored Trooper Votoms: The Last Red Shoulder , Armored Trooper Votoms: Big Battle , Armor Hunter Mellowlink , Armored Trooper Votoms: Red Shoulder Document - Roots of Treachery , Armored Trooper Votoms: Pailsen Files , and Armored Trooper Votoms: The Heretic Saint . Armored Trooper Votoms: Alone Again , the latest entry in the series until now, debuted in 2011.

title: Identity V Game's Oha Suta Daigo Gakuen Short Anime Unveils More Cast, Staff, November 24 Debut
content:
The staff for the Oha Suta children's variety show announced on Tuesday the episode titles, main cast and staff members, and the November 24 premiere for the Oha Suta Daigo Gakuen (Good Morning Studio: V Academy) anime . The four-episode weekly short anime is based on Oha Suta's segment where the hosts play the Identity V video game.

The short anime's four episodes are:

Episode 1: "Dodgeball Taiketsu" (Dodgeball Showdown), airing on November 24

Episode 2: "Test-chū wa Oshizuka ni" (Please Be Quiet During the Exam), airing on December 1

Episode 3: "Yukidaruma o Tsukurō" (Let's Build a Snowman), airing on December 8

Episode 4: "Tanoshii Christmas" (Merry Christmas), airing on December 15

The cast and characters from the Identity V game that will appear in the anime are:

• Chiwa Saitō as Emma

• Takehito Koyasu as Forward William

• Nobunaga Shimazaki as Andrew the Gravedigger

• Yūichirō Umehara as Luca the Prisoner

• Makoto Furukawa as Teacher Jack the Ripper

Shizuka Kusakabe is the director, technical director, storyboard artist, and character designer at Type ZERO . Haruki Oomori draws the animation frames, and Hitman Nakamura is in charge of animation. Shinyu Watabe (name romanization not confirmed) is directing the sound, Kenichirō Imamura is in charge of sound effects, Honami Sugie is the Recording Engineer , and Bit Grooove Promotion is in charge of sound production.

The short anime version of Daigo Gakuen depicts the daily school life of Identity V 's gardener character Emma (voiced in Japanese by Chiwa Saitō ) and other survivors as students — with the game's Jack or The Ripper character as their teacher.

In the regular live-action Daigo Gakuen segment, voice actor Subaru Kimura (who goes by the nickname Suba-nii on the show to reflect his older, mentor-like personality towards the children) and "Oha Kids" cast members try out the latest modes of NetEase Games ' survival horror game Identity V . The second season of this video game segment started on September 8.

Like the live-action Daigo Gakuen segment, the short anime will play within the Oha Suta program, which airs on the TV Tokyo channel and its affiliates every weekday at 7:05 a.m.

NetEase Games launched the Identity V game on smartphones in China in April 2018, and then rolled out the game worldwide (including in Japan) in July 2018. In the game, four players assume the role of survivors against another player as a hunter. The game has a worldwide userbase of over 400 million.

title: 'Isekai Munchkin' Reveals New Staff, Theme Songs, Second Promo
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Yuu Shimizu and Makoto Aogiri 's Isekai Munchkin: HP1 no Mama de Saikyou Saisoku Dungeon Kouryaku ( Otherworldly Munchkin: Let's Speedrun the Dungeon with Only 1 HP! ) manga revealed additional cast, new staff, a second key visual (pictured), the theme songs, and second promotional video on Wednesday. The anime series will premiere on January 8 at 12:30 a.m. on Tokyo MX, followed by Me-Television and Gunma TV.

Voice actor Yuuichiro Umehara ( Goblin Slayer II ) is joining the cast as Jaraza.

Staff Director: Naoya Fukushi ( Nazotokine ) Series Composition: Hiroshi Hosokawa Character Design: Mamoru Yokota ( Mahou Senshi Louie ), Yui Katou ( Kaito x Ansa ) Sub Character Design: Yurika Sako ( Edens Zero character design) Prop Design: Tengu Koubou Creature Design: Tengu Koubou CG Director: Yui Horiuchi ( Blue Period 3DCG) Color Design: Tengu Koubou NEW Main Color Design: Youko Watanabe ( Hikari no Ou ) NEW Art Director: Masakazu Miyake ( Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku wo! ) Art Production: Cre-p NEW Director of Photography: Shigeki Asakawa ( Shingeki no Kyojin: The Final ) Season Editing: TAVAC NEW Sound Director: Yasunori Ebina ( Naruto ) Sound Production: Sonilude Music: Asami Tachibana ( Yuukoku no Moriarty ) Music Production: Lantis Production Cooperation: Tengu Koubou Cooperation: Wizards of the Coast Studio: Durandal

Note: The staff denoted with the legend NEW are new in their respective roles .

The opening theme song "Sai" will be performed by LIL LEAGUE , while singer ZAQ performs the ending theme song "Zanka." The opening theme is previewed in the second promotional video below.

Shimizu (Seireitsukai no Blade Dance) and Aogiri began serializing the manga on the Suiyoubi no Sirius website in February 2019. Kodansha published the 14th volume on May 8.

Kodansha USA licensed the manga in English for digital release in October 2020 and released the 14th volume on August 4.

title: 4 More Anime Still Coming to Netflix in 2026
content:
2026 is heading towards the final month of the year, as the Fall 2026 anime season will wrap up along with the year. The final quarter of the year began last month, when all major platforms released exciting new shows for fans worldwide. It’s no surprise that Crunchyroll had the biggest lineup, just like every other quarter. As the world’s largest anime streaming service, Crunchyroll releases dozens of series each quarter on a weekly schedule. On the other hand, Netflix has been venturing into the anime industry for the past few years with original series and new licenses. Instead of following a season schedule, Netflix often focuses on new releases every month.

These anime are usually newly licensed shows and even sequels that are added to the platform. Initially, the November lineup wasn’t all that exciting, with only two new releases. ComicBook previously covered that Fool Night and Boss x Machina are scheduled to be released this month. However, later on, What’s on Netflix expanded the November 2026 anime lineup with more exciting releases. Check out the new anime that have already arrived on the platform this month as well as the upcoming new licenses fans have been waiting for.

4) One Piece Season 35

Netflix dropped new One Piece episodes on November 15th, 2026. While the Elbaph Arc is ongoing, Netflix is also planning to bring some of the previous episodes to its library. Aside from the Egghead and the Elbaph Arcs, the streaming giant currently has only 877 episodes of the anime, leaving the Whole Cake Island Arc incomplete. Since 2020, Netflix has been adding arcs by dividing them into seasons or different parts, so fans can finally stream it all in one go. More parts will be added in the next few months, and the dates will be revealed later. Following this batch of new episodes, the anime will have to include the Wano Country Saga, one of the longest Sagas in the story, to finally stream all the available episodes.

The arc takes place after the Straw Hats were split into two teams during the Zou Arc. The team with Zoro, Robin, and the others heads towards Wano with Trafalgar Law and members of the Kozuki Clan. On the other hand, Luffy, Nami, and the rest of the team invade the stronghold of Big Mom, one of the four Emperors of the Sea. Sanji had to leave the crew after being threatened by his family to marry one of Big Mom’s daughters and form an alliance with the pirate crew.

3) Black Butler

Whether it’s the premise or the storytelling, Black Butler stands out for having unique elements that are appreciated by fans even now. Since the anime is commemorating a major milestone this year , fans can also expect new surprises, including an exhibition, merchandise, and much more. Additionally, What’s on Netflix confirmed that the first two seasons of the hit supernatural series will return to the platform on November 15th, 2026. However, the other installments of the franchise, including the sequel seasons and the movies, haven’t been confirmed to drop on Netflix yet, but we can expect an update in the next few months.

Among the 2000s anime classics, Black Butler still stands out for its exceptional storytelling and complex characters. Written and illustrated by Yana Toboso, this award-winning manga began serializing in Square Enix’s GFantasy magazine on September 16th, 2006. This dark fantasy centers around a young boy named Ciel Phantomhive who sold his soul to a demon named Sebastian. The series is still ongoing and continues to return with new seasons, which is all the more reason why Netflix is bringing back the series to its library.

2) My Hero Academia Season 6

Amid all the new announcements, What’s on Netflix confirmed that the streaming giant is finally bringing Season 6 to its library on June 1st, 2026. Despite the anime’s success, the platform is lagging in content as it didn’t have Season 6 until now, even though Season 7 is already streaming. While Season 8 also awaits a streaming date, the platform will be streaming the fan-favorite film, My Hero Academia: World Heroes’ Mission , on November 19th as well. While the season was confirmed to begin streaming earlier this year, there was a major delay from Netflix.

The reason behind the delay was never announced, but now fans will finally get to stream the entire series along with the four movies. The anime released four films over the years, and they often get added or removed from the U.S. library due to licensing issues. World Heroes’ Mission was originally released in 2021, while Season 6 premiered in October 2022, more than three years ago.

1) Blue Exorcist Season 3

The manga has been ongoing since 2009, and thanks to its huge fan base, the anime keeps returning with sequels. While Blue Exorcist is yet another series with a different premise, it shares similarities through the protagonist. Both protagonists are feared as Devils, but they turn out to be innocent teenagers with heartwarming personalities that make everyone around them root for them. Not to mention that they start off as powerful, so unlike My Hero Academia , we don’t get to see the underdog trope.

Blue Exorcist comes off as more slice-of-life with an action-driven narrative. The latest season, Blue Exorcist: Shimane Illuminati Saga , was released in 2024, but a sequel might take longer than expected since the manga runs on a monthly schedule. This is why it will take a while before enough chapters are released for the animation studio to release a new season.

Are you excited about these new anime? Which of these anime will you watch next month? Head down to the comments to let us know.

contentBlocks.text: 2026 is heading towards the final month of the year, as the Fall 2026 anime season will wrap up along with the year. The final quarter of the year began last month, when all major platforms released exciting new shows for fans worldwide. It’s no surprise that Crunchyroll had the biggest lineup, just like every other quarter. As the world’s largest anime streaming service, Crunchyroll releases dozens of series each quarter on a weekly schedule. On the other hand, Netflix has been venturing into the anime industry for the past few years with original series and new licenses. Instead of following a season schedule, Netflix often focuses on new releases every month.

These anime are usually newly licensed shows and even sequels that are added to the platform. Initially, the November lineup wasn’t all that exciting, with only two new releases. ComicBook previously covered that Fool Night and Boss x Machina are scheduled to be released this month. However, later on, What’s on Netflix expanded the November 2026 anime lineup with more exciting releases. Check out the new anime that have already arrived on the platform this month as well as the upcoming new licenses fans have been waiting for.
4) One Piece Season 35

contentBlocks.credit: Image Courtesy of Toei Animation

contentBlocks.text: Netflix dropped new One Piece episodes on November 15th, 2026. While the Elbaph Arc is ongoing, Netflix is also planning to bring some of the previous episodes to its library. Aside from the Egghead and the Elbaph Arcs, the streaming giant currently has only 877 episodes of the anime, leaving the Whole Cake Island Arc incomplete. Since 2020, Netflix has been adding arcs by dividing them into seasons or different parts, so fans can finally stream it all in one go. More parts will be added in the next few months, and the dates will be revealed later. Following this batch of new episodes, the anime will have to include the Wano Country Saga, one of the longest Sagas in the story, to finally stream all the available episodes.

The arc takes place after the Straw Hats were split into two teams during the Zou Arc. The team with Zoro, Robin, and the others heads towards Wano with Trafalgar Law and members of the Kozuki Clan. On the other hand, Luffy, Nami, and the rest of the team invade the stronghold of Big Mom, one of the four Emperors of the Sea. Sanji had to leave the crew after being threatened by his family to marry one of Big Mom’s daughters and form an alliance with the pirate crew.
3) Black Butler

contentBlocks.credit: Image Courtesy of A-1 Pictures

contentBlocks.text: Whether it’s the premise or the storytelling, Black Butler stands out for having unique elements that are appreciated by fans even now. Since the anime is commemorating a major milestone this year , fans can also expect new surprises, including an exhibition, merchandise, and much more. Additionally, What’s on Netflix confirmed that the first two seasons of the hit supernatural series will return to the platform on November 15th, 2026. However, the other installments of the franchise, including the sequel seasons and the movies, haven’t been confirmed to drop on Netflix yet, but we can expect an update in the next few months.

Among the 2000s anime classics, Black Butler still stands out for its exceptional storytelling and complex characters. Written and illustrated by Yana Toboso, this award-winning manga began serializing in Square Enix’s GFantasy magazine on September 16th, 2006. This dark fantasy centers around a young boy named Ciel Phantomhive who sold his soul to a demon named Sebastian. The series is still ongoing and continues to return with new seasons, which is all the more reason why Netflix is bringing back the series to its library.
2) My Hero Academia Season 6

contentBlocks.credit: Image Courtesy of BONES

contentBlocks.text: Amid all the new announcements, What’s on Netflix confirmed that the streaming giant is finally bringing Season 6 to its library on June 1st, 2026. Despite the anime’s success, the platform is lagging in content as it didn’t have Season 6 until now, even though Season 7 is already streaming. While Season 8 also awaits a streaming date, the platform will be streaming the fan-favorite film, My Hero Academia: World Heroes’ Mission , on November 19th as well. While the season was confirmed to begin streaming earlier this year, there was a major delay from Netflix.

The reason behind the delay was never announced, but now fans will finally get to stream the entire series along with the four movies. The anime released four films over the years, and they often get added or removed from the U.S. library due to licensing issues. World Heroes’ Mission was originally released in 2021, while Season 6 premiered in October 2022, more than three years ago.
1) Blue Exorcist Season 3

contentBlocks.credit: Image Courtesy of A-1 Pictures

contentBlocks.text: The manga has been ongoing since 2009, and thanks to its huge fan base, the anime keeps returning with sequels. While Blue Exorcist is yet another series with a different premise, it shares similarities through the protagonist. Both protagonists are feared as Devils, but they turn out to be innocent teenagers with heartwarming personalities that make everyone around them root for them. Not to mention that they start off as powerful, so unlike My Hero Academia , we don’t get to see the underdog trope.

Blue Exorcist comes off as more slice-of-life with an action-driven narrative. The latest season, Blue Exorcist: Shimane Illuminati Saga , was released in 2024, but a sequel might take longer than expected since the manga runs on a monthly schedule. This is why it will take a while before enough chapters are released for the animation studio to release a new season.

title: Naruto’s Creator Has the Chance to Redeem Himself From His Biggest Failure
content:
While fans hope Naruto ’s new manga will focus on Naruto and Team 7, it might be about the next generation instead. Ever since the original creator announced Naruto’ s new manga at the recent New York Comic Con, fans have naturally been looking forward to seeing what Kishimoto has planned for the beloved original characters. Meanwhile, fans are worried that the new manga could make the sequel, Boruto , irrelevant, while fans of the sequel fear it could overshadow Boruto and prevent the series from receiving the attention it deserves.

However, the new manga, Naruto: Shadow Rising , could instead do the opposite. The teaser revealed that the series will focus on the period after the events of Shippuden and before Naruto became Hokage. This suggests that the series will follow Naruto’s journey toward becoming Hokage, advancing through the ranks, and possibly going on missions alongside Sakura and his other teammate, Sasuke, with Team 7 back on missions under Kakashi’s guidance. While these events could be featured, the new manga’s main focus could actually be bridging the gap between Naruto and the next generation, and the teaser also hints that it will focus on Boruto and the next generation.

What Is Naruto: Shadow Rising About?

Naruto: Shadow Rising features Kishimoto returning with a new manga story, but it’s yet to be revealed what kind of shape this new story will take. It could be a single one-shot story focusing on a time Naruto and Sasuke fought before Naruto became the Hokage ( something that was not shown during the events of the main series ), or it could be a miniseries with multiple chapters set to release much like other sequels of its kind like Jujutsu Kaisen Modulo . But there are still many other questions surrounding this return that just keep popping up.

Naruto Shadow Rising seems to take place after the original series, but before the events of the Boruto: Naruto Next Generations sequel . It’s kind of like Dragon Ball Super’ s situation where it can’t do too much without interfering with the canon of its future events seen in the sequel, but that franchise has gone on for so long that it’s basically become its own timeline. That could be the case with this manga return, or it could end after a single chapter. We’ll find out soon enough when it takes the stage during Jump Festa 2027 later this year.

The teaser for Naruto: Shadow Rising now hints that the manga could focus on filling this gap. Specifically, the new illustrations showcase Naruto’s Hokage statue being built and Sarada with her newborn daughter. This suggests that the manga will explore events surrounding the period when Naruto and other original characters, including Sasuke and Shikamaru, started having children. With Naruto’s priorities shifting from becoming Hokage for his own sake to caring for others, particularly the next generation, this manga could explore that transition. It could focus on Naruto and his companions navigating parenthood as they work to secure a better future for the next generation.

Naruto Creator Can Finally Save His Legacy After the Failure of Samurai 8

It feels like it wasn’t long ago since news went live about Samurai 8, but its end is already here. A few years back saw artist Masashi Kishimoto return to work following his iconic run with Naruto , and Samurai 8 was his big prize. The sci-fi series is one which Kishimoto had been wanting to do for years, and his newfound freedom gave him a chance to pursue the project. But just after a year of being published, the manga has come to an end .

Fans had a lot of emotions about the manga, and its ending has sparked some passionate reactions. While some are glad to be rid of the series, others are far more frustrated by the early ending. Weekly Shonen Jump isn’t afraid to axe underperforming series , and Samurai 8 hasn’t done well in sales so far. Japanese audiences never caught onto the sci-fi series, but those who did read the manga are sad to see all its potential lost.

This abrupt end marks the final chapter of Samurai 8 and its legacy . There is no word on whether Kishimoto or Okubo have projects lined up in the wake of this finale. For the former, he could always circle back to Boruto: Naruto Next Generations , but Kishimoto certainly deserves a break if he wants one. And if that is the case, fans are more than ready to give him and Okubo all the rest they need to launch a comeback.

Do you think Masashi Kishimoto can redeem himself with this sequel after Samurai 8 ‘s cancellation? What are your expectations for Naruto: Shadow Rising ? Share your thoughts in the comments.

title: Yaiba: Samurai Legend Season 2 Reveals Cast Member Yūma Uchida, Opening Song Artists
content:
The official website for the second season of Yaiba: Samurai Legend ( Shin Samurai-den YAIBA ), the new television anime of Detective Conan creator Gōshō Aoyama 's Yaiba manga, announced on Wednesday that it has cast Yūma Uchida as Gekkō (seen below). Sony Music also announced that CHICO with Honeyworks will perform the opening theme song "CHASE!" for the second season.

The second season will cover the "Kaguya Arc." Ami Koshimizu will play Kaguya and Kōki Uchiyama will play Tsukikage.

Takahiro Hasui (episode director for Aikatsu Friends! , Mob Psycho 100 II ) is returning to direct the anime at Wit Studio , with animation cooperation by Studio Kurm .

Tōko Machida ( 7th Time Loop: The Villainess Enjoys a Carefree Life , The IDOLM@STER ) is again in charge or series scripts, and Yoshimichi Kameda (chief animation director for INU-OH film) is again the character designer and chief animation director. Takeshi Maenami (key animator for Ni no Kuni , Uma Musume Pretty Derby: Beginning of a New Era films) is again the sub-character designer and main animator. Yutaka Yamada ( Tokyo Ghoul ) and Yoshiaki Dewa ( IRODUKU: The World in Colors ) are returning to compose the music. Haru Yamada ( IRODUKU: The World in Colors , Made in Abyss ) is the sound director, and Maiko Okada ( Great Pretender razbliuto , After the Rain ) is returning as the animation producer.

Other new and returning staff members include:

• Art Director: Yūsuke Takeda (Bamboo)

• Background Art: Kazushi Fujii

• Color Design: Satoshi Hashimoto

• Director of Photography: Yūdai Oda (Follum) (new)

• Editing: Kiyoshi Hirose

• Sound Effects: Eiko Morikawa

The new season will premiere on January 9, 2027 and will again air on YTV , NTV , and their affiliates on Saturdays at 5:30 p.m. JST (3:30 a.m. EST).

The first season premiered in April 2025 on YTV , NTV , and their affiliates throughout Japan and aired on Saturdays at 5:30 p.m., right before Detective Conan 's 6:00 p.m. timeslot to start the " Gōshō Aoyama Hour" block. The second cours (quarter of a year) premiered in June 2025.

The anime streams on Netflix in North America, Latin America, Australia, and New Zealand. The show also streams on Hulu in the United States.

Viz Media has licensed the anime, and the company describes the story:

Ya iba Kurogane has spent his days training in the jungle in order to attain his goal of becoming a real samurai. By a twist of fate, he returns to Japan and starts living with the Mine family, who are connected to his father, Kenjuro. Ya iba constantly baffles the Mines' daughter Sayaka as she witnesses his wild and reckless ways. One day, Ya iba tags along with Sayaka to school and has a fateful encounter with Takeshi Onimaru, a kendo expert. Ya iba and Onimaru repeatedly clash, and as if in response to their search for strength, two ancient powers are unleashed: the Fujinken, the Wind God's Sword, and the Raijinken, the Thunder God's Sword. Both supernatural blades that have jolted the world since ancient days have reawakened...and the truth behind them is revealed!

Aoyama launched the manga in Shogakukan 's Weekly Shonen Sunday in September 1988. The series concluded in December 1993 with a total of 24 compiled book volumes.

The series inspired a 52-episode anime adaptation that ran from April 1993-April 1994.

Viz Media is also releasing the manga in English.

title: Demon Slayer’s Infinity Castle Future Faces a Major Problem
content:
Demon Slayer recently released the first installment of its Infinity Castle trilogy in U.S. theaters, and it’s already smashing box office records . The film commences the highly anticipated showdown between the Demon Slayer Corps and the demons. Ever since Nezuko conquered the sun, Muzan has been gathering demons from across the country to help him find the girl. The demons are also ordered to remain on standby should they encounter any Demon Slayers. With demon attacks being almost negligible, the Corps was able to complete the Hashira Training successfully. Unfortunately, after locating their headquarters, Muzan seized the opportunity, deciding it would be easier to annihilate the Corps by trapping them inside the Infinity Castle.

What follows is a series of intense battles filled with heart-wrenching moments. The first installment has already struck fans hard by killing off several beloved characters, and unfortunately, there’s much more to come. Last year, following the Hashira Training Arc finale, Ufotable announced a trilogy adaptation of the final arc. At the time, it was widely assumed that both the Infinity Castle and Sunrise Countdown arcs would be included. However, after the release of the first part, the chances of the trilogy covering the entire final stretch now seem slim.

Demon Slayer Has Too Many Chapters Left to Adapt in Just Two Films

The final arc is divided into two parts: the Infinity Castle Arc and the Sunrise Countdown Arc. The Infinity Castle Arc alone spans 44 chapters, of which only 17 were adapted in the first installment. Despite the flashy animation and thrilling fight scenes, the fast pacing and exclusion of key scenes are impossible to overlook. The film ran for about 2 hours and 30 minutes, roughly the same length as the Infinity Train movie. But here’s the twist, the Infinity Train film adapted just 13 chapters within that same runtime, and few would argue it didn’t achieve far better pacing. If the latest film had tried to adapt its 17 chapters with the same level of detail, the runtime would have needed to stretch to nearly 3 hours, which simply isn’t practical.

The Infinity Castle Arc still has 27 chapters left to adapt in the upcoming installments, which is an ideal amount for a film. However, the Sunrise Countdown Arc spans 22 chapters, and it seems unlikely the trilogy will be able to squeeze this arc into the upcoming parts. This arc follows the surviving members of the Demon Slayer Corps as they put everything on the line to secure victory and defeat Muzan Kibutsuji. The full stretch of 22 chapters is more tragic than anything the series has shown before, ultimately concluding the story on a bittersweet note.

Should the Sunrise Countdown Arc Also Be Another Demon Slayer Movie?

Following the groundbreaking success of its two films, Ufotable releasing a final anime film isn’t completely out of the question. However, the story might be better experienced through weekly episodes. The first installment of the trilogy is spectacular in every way, but it doesn’t change the fact that it would have worked far better in a TV season format . We see several characters scattered throughout the castle, fighting demons while also searching for Muzan.

The first part alone features three major battles, each following the other in quick succession, which reduces the suspense of wondering, “What’s going to happen next?” The upcoming installments will likely follow the same pattern, since many characters still haven’t had their turn to fight. As for the Sunrise Countdown Arc, it may work better than Infinity Castle as a film, but the studio would need to release at least two movies to adapt it fully. Perhaps a single anime season would be a better choice.

The Corps’ situation only worsens after the Infinity Castle Arc, as they now face the impossible challenge of defeating Muzan himself. Most members are already injured or exhausted, and with the demon progenitor’s only weakness being the sun, their task becomes even more daunting. The Sunrise Countdown Arc is packed with heart-wrenching moments and cliffhangers that will keep the audience hooked until the very end. The first installment of Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle is currently showing in theaters, so be sure to catch it on the big screen. You can also catch up with the anime on Crunchyroll and Netflix.

What are your expectations for the Sunrise Countdown Arc? Do you think Ufotable will continue making more movies, or will there finally be a TV show again? Share your thoughts in the comments below!

title: Otherworldly Munchkin Anime's New Video Reveals More Cast, Staff, Theme Songs, January 7 Debut
content:
Bandai Namco Filmworks presented a new promotional video and visual for the anime of Yū Shimizu and Makoto Aogiri 's Otherworldly Munchkin: Let's Speedrun the Dungeon with Only 1 HP ( Isekai Munchkin: HP 1 no Mama de Saikyō Saisoku Danjon Kōryaku ) manga on Wednesday. The video announces a new cast member, some staff changes, and the new January 7 premiere date for the anime. It also previews the anime's opening theme song "Sai" (Dice) by LIL LEAGUE and ending theme song "Zanka" (Lingering Flame) by ZAQ .

Makoto Aogiri also drew the below illustration to celebrate the anime.

The anime will premiere on the Tokyo MX and BS11 channels on January 7 at 24:30 (effectively, January 8 at 12:30 a.m.), and then run on Nagoya TV , Gunma TV , and MBS . The anime was previously slated to premiere in October 2025, but was delayed just one month before the original debut date in order to "improve the quality" of the anime. Crunchyroll will stream the anime.

Yūichirō Umehara joins the cast Sharaza ( romanization not confirmed ).

The anime's cast members include:

• Kazuki Ura as Yukito Kirihara

• Kana Yūki as Charlotte R. Brownia

• Yui Ishikawa as Lumilia Sherwood

• Kaori Maeda as Liverna Dark

• Hika Tsukishiro as Sana Kirihara

• Fukushi Ochiai as Rocinante

• Ayasa Itō as Managarmr

title: 'Sakamoto Days 2nd Season' Unveils Additional Cast, Opening Theme, First Promo
content:
The official website of the Sakamoto Days television anime unveiled a pair of additional cast, key visual (pictured), the opening theme, and first promotional video for the second season on Wednesday. The anime adapting Yuuto Suzuki 's action comedy manga is scheduled to premiere on TV Tokyo and its affiliated networks on January 19, 2027, at 12:00 a.m. It will also air on BS TV Tokyo on January 25 at 12:40 a.m. The first episode will be available for advance streaming on Netflix.

Voice actors Kenyuu Horiuchi ( Dorohedoro ) and Kishou Taniyama ( Bungou Stray Dogs ) are joining the cast as Byoudou and Club Jam, respectively.

Hip-hop unit Creepy Nuts ( Dandadan ) is performing the opening theme "Papa wa imadani Juvenile," which previewed in the first promotional video below.

Daisuke Nakajima ( The Fable series director) is directing the second season at TMS Entertainment , replacing Masaki Watanabe . Taku Kishimoto ( Ijiranaide, Nagatoro-san ) is handling the series composition. You Moriyama ( Megalo Box director) is designing the characters. Yuuki Hayashi ( Boku no Hero Academia ) is composing the music.

Produced by TMS Entertainment, the first anime season aired in split cours in Winter 2025 and Summer 2025. Netflix streamed the anime with multiple subtitles and an English dub.

Suzuki began drawing the action comedy manga in Weekly Shounen Jump in November 2020. Shueisha published the 29th volume on November 4.

VIZ Media licensed the manga for English release in July 2021 and published the 23th volume on September 15, with the 24th volume scheduled for release on December 15. Shueisha began simulpublishing the manga in English on its Manga plus website in November 2020.
